newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian president reshuffles party leadership.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian president reshuffles party leadership.

text.p: President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali reshuffled on Wednesday the leadership of Tunisia's ruling party, an official statement said.
The changes at the politburo of the Constitutional Democratic Rally (RCD) follows a shake up in the cabinet on January 20.
Abderrahim Zouari, who was named Foreign Affairs Minister, and Mohamed Ben Rejeb, new Interior Minister, were brought into the politburo.
Mohamed Jeri, named Finance Minister, left the body.
The RCD is chaired by President Ben Ali and Prime Minister Hamed Karoui is vice-president. Abdelaziz Ben Dhia was confirmed as its secretary general.
